items.title: Joseph "Fan" Bourgeau Interview, 1972-09-13
items.q: I said, well, I know her.

ctx.x: Yeah, the actress. She said, I've been there and stopped there. I said, well, I know her. She said, you speak French mighty good. I told her I speak French too. I mean, they always.
You mean this was a French woman?
I don't know if she was French, but I told her I speak French, you know?
